findings.issue: --stale-templates may drop the template of another active worktree (datname !== CURRENT_TEMPLATE includes hashes that are 'current' for a different branch). ADR amendment T-0192 does not document this limitation explicitly.
findings.suggestion: Add a warning to the ADR and to the script help-text: 'do not run --stale-templates while other worktrees may be using their templates'. No auto-CI exposure since --stale-templates is an explicit opt-in flag.

findings.issue: computeMigrationsHash is duplicated in 3 files. A shared ci/checks/db/migrations-hash.ts helper (builtins only) would eliminate duplication without violating FF-T147-3.
findings.suggestion: Extract computeMigrationsHash to ci/checks/db/migrations-hash.ts; import from all three callers. Acceptable as a follow-up task, not blocking current delivery.
